description: This file contains server-side logic for the profile page in a SvelteKit application. It handles loading user profile data from a Django REST API, including user details and profile information, as well as updating the profile with new data submitted through a form. It performs input validation and interacts with external helper modules for API requests and phone number validation/formatting.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads user profile data by making an API request to the Django backend, processes the response to match Prisma-like structure, and redirects to login if user is not authenticated.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Handles form submission for updating user profile, validates input fields, transforms data to match Django API expectations, and sends a PATCH request to update the profile. Returns success or error messages based on outcome.

calls: apiRequest('/profile/', { method: 'PATCH', body: djangoData }, { cookies, org })
